profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Former Santa Clara University student with a B.S. in Computer Engineering and B.S in Bioengineering. Part time drummer, full time software engineer. Passionate about the future of neuroscience and brain-computer interfaces, learning, and pushing my mental limits.

Interests:
Neuroscience // Brain-Computer Interfaces // Software Engineering // Developing on Emerging Technologies // Indie Game Development

Technical Skills:
C/C++, Java, Python, Javascript, Node.js, React.js

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed on a variety of platforms including (but not limited to): Leap Motion Controller, Google Glass, Android OS, LibGDX framework.

positions.title: Full Stack Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed a web application based on new technologies such as Node.js, Facebook's React.js, and Loopback for the backend systems. Designed core modules to be used within the website, and expedited the process of interaction between the operations team and customers.

volunteerExperiences.description: Tutored high school students as part of the AVID program at Santa Clara High School.

projects.title: Google Glass and Android Development
projects.description: Developing a dynamic scheduling application for use on mobile devices and the Google Glass. Although discontinued, the use of the Glass is to create the most convenient method of displaying both a user's schedule and our system's suggestions based on the user-defined preferences.

projects.title: Leap Motion Development
projects.description: Created a Java-based program with the Leap Motion Controller to control any basic platforming video game using hand movements. Provides a more entertaining alternative to basic controller or keyboard control styles with comparable precision and effectiveness.
